source_tex: \begin{aligned}\text{Total Possible Outcomes} & =\text{Number of outcomes when the coin is flipped the first time} \\  & \times \text{Number of outcomes when the coin is flipped the second time} \\  & \times \text{Number of outcomes when the six-sided die is rolled the first time} \\  & \times \text{Number of outcomes when the six-sided die is rolled the second time} \\  & \times \text{Number of outcomes when the six-sided die is rolled the third time} \\  & \times \text{Number of outcomes when the tetrahedral die is rolled the one time} \\  & =2\times 2\times 6\times 6\times 6\times 4 \\  & ={2}^{2}\times {6}^{3}\times 4 \\  & =4\times 216\times 4 \\  & =3\hspace{0.167em}456.\end{aligned}
